items.title: Wolof & Mandinka Defense
items.detail: Organized West African state militaries confront Portuguese raiders south of the Senegal.

items.title: Rising Coercive Cost
items.detail: Poisoned arrows and shallow coastal waters kill European landing parties.

items.detail: Crown requires supranational ecclesiastical title and moral immunization for Christian Europe.
